{{Top}}
A '''flexclamp''' was a surgical instrument found in a [[Medpac/Legends|medi-pack]]. It comprised three adjustable claws which were attached to the end of a flexible shaft. Flexclamps were used to pinch off a being's [[Blood/Legends|blood]] vessels in areas that were difficult to operate on.
